title: Gesso
description: Not only is earth the oldest building material in the world, it was also the first pigment used by man to add colour both to himself and to his surrounding environment. From this experience an exciting new use originated, which upheld the traditions of Italy and led to the creation of a selection of clay mixtures with highimpact colour and dynamic textures. With this collection, our aim was to enhance the ancestral origins of earth as a material. By combining the patterns and textures of earth with pure pigments, the material takes on a starring role, transformed into a new, intense, and ever-changing tiling option.

title: Elements Pebbles Beige
description: Casalgrande Padana presents Elements , its new collection of porcelain stoneware tiles that comes in three finishes – Essence , Pebbles , and Texture – a perfectly balanced colour palette, and modular formats. In particular, Essence stands out for its exquisite wood effect, Pebbles for its interplay of solid and void, and Texture for its delicate spatula strokes and cloud-like patterns. The new Elements tile collection is incredibly versatile and offers a wide range of customisation options. It’s where urban chic meets the warmth and beauty of wood for fascinating, creative compositions. Innovative combinations capture the very essence of the materials, creating new ways to imagine spaces where details can be mixed and matched to deliver an extraordinary tactile, visual and sensory experience. The three finishes of the Elements porcelain stoneware tiles can be arranged in elegant tone-on-tone or contrasting colour combinations to create smooth transitions between different areas of the home or define functional areas both indoors and outdoors.
finishes: Bocciardata R11, Natural R10

title: Texture Canvas Beige
description:
Casalgrande Padana presents Elements , its new collection of porcelain stoneware tiles that comes in three finishes – Essence , Pebbles , and Texture – a perfectly balanced colour palette, and modular formats. In particular, Essence stands out for its exquisite wood effect, Pebbles for its interplay of solid and void, and Texture for its delicate spatula strokes and cloud-like patterns.

With its soft touch, the original feel and appearance of the Canvas surface, and the Canneté slatted wood option, Texture is ideal for simple, balanced spaces. It adapts easily to any style, from Art Deco inspirations to minimalist settings, and looks great in Scandinavian, classic, industrial chic or eclectic interiors.

The new Elements tile collection is incredibly versatile and offers a wide range of customisation options. It’s where urban chic meets the warmth and beauty of wood for fascinating, creative compositions. Innovative combinations capture the very essence of the materials, creating new ways to imagine spaces where details can be mixed and matched to deliver an extraordinary tactile, visual and sensory experience. The three finishes of the Elements porcelain stoneware tiles can be arranged in elegant tone-on-tone or contrasting colour combinations to create smooth transitions between different areas of the home or define functional areas both indoors and outdoors.
finishes: Canvas, Matt

title: Aventino Vein
description:
Precious Italian heritage full of charm and history comes to life in the porcelain stoneware tiles from the new Pietra Tiburtina collection, achieving the perfect balance between design, craftsmanship, creativity, and innovation.

Fragments of stone gush from the caves of ancient Tibur to take us on a journey through history. Ancient Romans used travertine – or lapis tiburtinus, as they used to call it – as an ornamental and construction material. Centuries later, this natural stone has maintained its unlimited potential, inspiring artists and architects of every era.

Casalgrande Padana’s new Pietra Tiburtina collection comes in both a vein-cut version, which emphasises the lengthwise layers of limestone, and a cross-cut version, with an antiqued finish also available, which highlights the subtle cloud-like effects and gives the tiles an aged flavour of times gone by. Both versions combine stone’s charm and porcelain stoneware’s sturdiness. Delicate earthy shades, beautiful streaks, and a three-dimensional play of light and shadow give these tiles a texture full of charm and elegance.
finishes: Grip R11 PTV>36, Matt, Rigata, Smooth

The collection Dakota by Rosa Splendiani represents the perfect combination of tradition and innovation, nature and technique.

The Dakota series coffee table is made of solid teak in a natural finish.

The refined and essential line, the high quality of the materials , the perfect balance between design and tradition, make the coffee table Dakota suitable to furnish both indoor and outdoor spaces.

Measurements: Width: 60 cm; Depth: 100 cm; Height: 32 cm

The line "Dakota" was born in ROSA CREATIVE LAB .

In its in-house studio, in fact, the team Rosa Splendiani in collaboration with free lance designers, elaborates ideas and carries out continuous research on materials. In this way, products and concepts always in step with the trends of the moment come to life.
